definition: Colorful corn — refers to a promiscuous person who is visibly flashy; phallic/vaginal metaphor for availability
Sexual teacher — ironic term for a promiscuous person; literally 'sexual instructor'
notes: Ironic: so promiscuous they're like an expert

definition: One who walks everywhere seeking sex; literally 'one who walks all around'
notes: Movement metaphor for sexual promiscuity

definition: Pejorative for a sexually loose woman; literally 'bush child'
notes: Used specifically of promiscuous women

definition: Everyone's person; a promiscuous individual available to all
Ironic promiscuity term; literally 'benefactor of all' — sarcastically, one who gives sex to everyone
notes: Ironic inversion of generosity for promiscuity

term: Ẹni tó ṣiṣe pẹ̀lú gbogbo ènìyàn
definition: One who has sex with everyone; literally 'person who does it with all people'
Ultimate lineage insult invoking maternal sexual shame; 'your mother is a prostitute'
notes: Appears again here in ancestry section; among the most offensive Yoruba insults

definition: Extreme lineage insult; literally 'your father is a sodomite'
notes: Paternal sexual shame insult; very offensive

definition: Lineage insult extending sexual shame across an entire family; literally 'prostitute family'
notes: Extends the insult beyond the individual to condemn the entire lineage

definition: Child of shame; illegitimacy insult; literally 'child of shame/degradation'
notes: Also appears in insults section; here in ancestry context

definition: Child of implied illegitimacy; literally 'child of that place' — vaguely implies unknown/shameful origin
notes: The vagueness ('that place') is itself an insult — implying shame too deep to name

definition: Prostitute lineage — generational insult extending sexual shame across generations; literally 'prostitute lineage'
notes: Even more expansive than ìdílé aṣẹ́wó; condemns the lineage across generations

term: Ẹni tí a kò mọ baba rẹ̀
definition: One whose father is unknown; illegitimacy insult; literally 'person whose father is not known'
notes: Implies the mother's sexual promiscuity made paternity impossible to determine

definition: Slur for a gay man or sodomite; the primary term for this in Yoruba
notes: Appears three times in the dump (clinical, slurs, insults) — each reflecting a different register of the same term
